item.title: Polish ILR-33 Amber 2K rocket carries first customer payload
item.description: JOHANNESBURG — Poland’s Łukasiewicz Institute of Aviation launched its second ILR-33 Amber 2K suborbital rocket on Nov. 12, marking the first time the vehicle has carried a customer payload. The flight comes as Poland explores establishing permanent infrastructure to support a domestic commercial suborbital launch industry.
